1022.description: A standing rear delt row with a band, pulling the handles toward the chest. It trains the rear delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band handles with your palms facing each other and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the band towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下。
双手握住弹力带手柄，手掌相对，双臂向前伸展。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将弹力带拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1086.description: A powerful pull from a long position under the straps. It builds the lats and upper back.
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull explosively with your arms and back.
Bring your chest toward your hands.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

1150.description: Leaning forward with the straps, you straighten the elbow behind you to isolate the triceps.
instructions: Hold the handles and hinge forward with elbows by your sides.
Keep your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms and push them behind you.
Squeeze the triceps at the end.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
Keep your back flat.

1214.description: A low-incline dumbbell press with palms facing you. The reverse grip puts extra focus on the upper chest.
instructions: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with dumbbells held palms facing you.
Start with the dumbbells at your chest.
Press them up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to your chest.
Keep your elbows close to your body.

1278.description: Dumbbell fly with your upper back on an incline bench and your hips supported by a stability ball. It hits the upper chest and challenges balance.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on an exercise ball and roll forward until your upper back is resting on the incline bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在健身球上，向前滚动，直到上背部靠在倾斜的长凳上。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对，双臂伸至胸部上方。
将哑铃以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1342.description: Lie on your side with a stability ball supporting you and reach overhead. It stretches the lat and the side of your torso.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your head supported by the stability ball.
Place your top arm on the ball for stability.
Reach your top arm overhead and allow your torso to rotate slightly.
Feel the stretch in your lat muscles on the side of your body.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸展，头部由稳定球支撑。
将上臂放在球上以保持稳定性。
将上臂举过头顶，让躯干稍微旋转。
感受身体一侧背阔肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。

1406.description: A simple lying hamstring stretch that eases tightness at the back of the thigh.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Raise one leg and hold behind the thigh or calf.
Gently straighten the knee while pulling the leg toward you.
Keep your other leg flat and your back relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1470.description: A classic side plank that trains the obliques and hip stabilisers.
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and your legs straight.
Stack your feet or stagger them for balance.
Lift your hips to form a straight line from head to feet.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Hold for the planned time, then switch sides.

1534.description: A drill where you drop under a bar on your back into an overhead squat. It builds overhead stability and speed.
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back and take a wide snatch grip.
Dip a short way and drive up.
Drop into a squat while pressing the bar overhead.
Catch it with locked arms and your chest up.
Stand up with control and return the bar to your back.

1598.description: A squat holding the bar in the crooks of your elbows on the smith machine. It trains the legs while taxing the core and upper back.
instructions: Set the bar at waist height and hook your elbows under it with your arms crossed.
Unrack and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping your chest up and the bar close to your body.
Go until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your heels to stand and rerack when done.

1662.description: A dumbbell curl lying down with the arms wide. It emphasizes the inner biceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝上，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1726.description: A triceps extension with a rope while lying on the floor. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable machine and set it to the lowest position.
Lie on the floor facing up, with your head towards the cable machine.
Hold the rope with both hands, palms facing each other, and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Keep your upper arms stationary and slowly lower the rope towards your forehead, bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳子连接到缆绳机上并将其设置到最低位置。
面朝上躺在地板上，头朝向电缆机。
双手握住绳子，掌心相对，双臂伸直向上伸向天花板。
保持上臂静止，慢慢地将绳子放低到前额，弯曲肘部。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1790.description: Lying face down, your partner lifts your arms back to open your chest. A deep, controlled chest and shoulder stretch.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides and your forehead resting on the floor.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly lift your arms up and back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1854.description: A leg raise with slightly bent knees, a gentler version for the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Raise your legs until they are above your hips.
Lower slowly without letting your back arch.
Keep your core tight throughout.

1918.description: A seated figure four style stretch for the buttocks and deep hip rotators.
instructions: Sit upright on the floor or a chair and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Gently press the raised knee down and lean your chest forward with a long back until the buttock stretches.
Keep your spine long instead of collapsing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1982.description: A gentle rotation stretch for the shoulder joint.
instructions: Stand tall and bend one elbow to 90 degrees at your side.
Slowly rotate your forearm outward or inward, using the other hand to assist, until you feel the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow tucked in close to your body.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2110.description: Rotates the upper body from a standing position to stretch the abs and obliques and loosen the trunk.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Place your hands on your hips or hold them out to the sides.
Keep the hips facing forward and turn your upper body slowly to one side.
Look over your shoulder and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the front and rotate to the other side.

2302.description: A hooking kick with the lead leg that swings the heel across the target, building balance and hip control.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the lead knee and point it forward.
Extend the leg and hook the heel across the target.
Keep your supporting foot grounded and your core tight.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

2750.description: A one-legged deadlift where a wall helps you balance while the hamstrings and glutes do the work.
instructions: Stand near a wall, holding a dumbbell and resting one hand on it for balance.
Lift one leg behind you.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbell down your standing leg.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall, then switch legs.

2814.description: A one arm clean with a body twist followed by a press overhead. Builds power and coordination from hips to shoulder.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a weight in one hand low in front of you.
Pull it up to your shoulder with a hip drive and a slight turn of the body.
Turn your feet and hips back to face forward as you dip your knees.
Press the weight overhead until your arm locks.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

2878.description: A Pilates back extension on your belly that lifts the chest and strengthens the spine.
instructions: Lie face down with hands beside your chest and legs together.
Press your pubic bone into the mat and engage your glutes.
Press through your hands to lift your chest.
Keep your neck long and shoulders away from your ears.
Lower slowly with control and repeat.

2942.description: A kettlebell press at an angle between a front and a side raise path. It suits natural shoulder movement and builds pressing strength.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder and stand tall.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bell up and slightly out to the side in a diagonal path.
Lock out your arm without leaning back.
Lower under control, finish the reps, then switch arms.

3006.description: A seated hip abduction pushing your knees apart against a resistance band. Works the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on the sides of the chair or bench for support.
Engage your abductors (outer thigh muscles) and slowly push your knees apart, against the resistance of the band.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your knees back together.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
将阻力带缠绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
将双手放在椅子或长凳的两侧以获得支撑。
启动外展肌（大腿外侧肌肉），并克服弹力带的阻力，慢慢将膝盖分开。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢将膝盖放回一起。
重复所需的重复次数。

3198.description: Hopping diagonally forward in a zigzag pattern. It trains agility and lower leg power.
instructions: Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Hop forward and to one side.
Land softly on both feet.
Hop forward and to the other side.
Keep your hops light and quick.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

3326.description: A standing band pulldown done one arm at a time with a trunk twist. It trains your lats and adds core work.
instructions: Anchor a band high in front of you and hold both handles with arms overhead.
Stand tall in a staggered stance.
Pull one handle down toward your ribs while rotating your torso.
Keep your elbow tucked and shoulder down.
Return slowly and switch to the other arm.

3390.description: A calf raise from a raised step with a chair for balance, giving a deeper stretch and fuller range.
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step edge, holding a chair for balance.
Let your heels drop below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise as high onto your toes as you can.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly into the deep stretch.
Keep your knees almost straight.

3454.description: A loaded superman hold with dumbbells for the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down holding light dumbbells with arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral.

3518.description: A seated leg extension with a loop band around the ankle. It isolates the quadriceps.
instructions: Sit on a chair with a band anchored behind and looped around one ankle.
Start with your knee bent to 90 degrees.
Extend your leg until it is straight.
Squeeze the quad at the top.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

3582.description: A lunge followed by a jump where the legs switch in mid-air. It builds leg power and raises your heart rate.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Push off with your right foot and jump into the air, switching the position of your feet mid-air.
Land softly with your left foot forward and immediately lower your body into a lunge position.
Continue alternating between lunges and jumps for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
右脚蹬地，跳到空中，在空中改变脚的位置。
左脚向前轻柔落地，并立即将身体降低至弓步位置。
继续在弓步和跳跃之间交替进行所需的重复次数。

3710.description: A split squat with the front foot on a bosu ball for a deeper range and extra balance work.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a bosu ball, back foot behind you.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3774.description: A squat while holding the band out in front of you against sideways pull. It trains your legs and anti-rotation core strength.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands at your chest, then press it straight out.
Keep your hips and shoulders square as you squat down.
Stand back up while holding the band steady.
Complete your reps, then turn around and repeat on the other side.

3838.description: A crunch performed lying on a bench. It trains your abs with a slightly larger range of motion.
instructions: Lie on a bench with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands by your temples.
Curl your shoulders up, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

3966.description: A lunge held in place that ends with a kick from the back leg. It works the legs and balance.
instructions: Step into a lunge with your front knee over your ankle.
Lower down until both knees are bent.
Drive up through the front foot.
Swing the back leg forward in a kick.
Return to the lunge and repeat, then switch legs.

4030.description: Wide stance squat holding one dumbbell by its bar between the legs. It hits the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and toes turned out.
Hold the dumbbell vertically by its bar with both hands in front of you.
Sit your hips down while keeping your chest up.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

4094.description: A lunge combined with a rear delt fly on suspension straps, working legs, shoulders and upper back together.
instructions: Hold the straps with both hands, leaning back slightly with arms extended.
Step one foot forward into a lunge.
As you lower, pull your arms out wide in a rear fly.
Push through the front foot to return to standing and bring your hands together.
Switch legs on the next rep.

4158.description: A side crunch holding a weight to load the obliques. It builds strength along the sides of the waist.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and hold a weight against your chest.
Support your head lightly.
Crunch your top ribs toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your side.
Lower slowly without losing tension.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

4222.description: Gently rolling a handheld roller along the back and sides of the neck. It helps loosen stiff neck and upper trap muscles.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with relaxed shoulders.
Hold the roller by both handles behind your neck.
Roll gently up and down along one side with light pressure.
Avoid pressing on the spine itself.
Repeat on the other side.
Roll for 30-60 seconds and stop if it hurts.

4286.description: Big circles with your hips that loosen the joint and the muscles around it. A good warm-up for leg days.
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Place your hands on your hips.
Rotate your hips in a wide circle.
Do 10 circles in one direction.
Reverse and circle the other way.
Keep your shoulders still and your knees soft.

4350.description: A biceps curl performed lying on your back with a cable. The lying position keeps constant tension on the biceps.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pin your upper arms to the floor beside you.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

4414.description: A bench press with kettlebells hanging from bands on the bar. The swinging load forces your stabilising muscles to work harder.
instructions: Lie on a bench and unrack the barbell with kettlebells hung from bands.
Plant your feet and brace your core.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid chest.
Press it up to full extension while keeping the bar steady.
Rack the bar safely when finished.

4478.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the side of the trunk (external oblique). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your side of the trunk (external oblique) while lying on your side.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4542.description: A kettlebell version of the classic lift: swing it to the shoulder, then drive it overhead with a leg push.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge to grab it.
Swing it back between your legs, then drive your hips forward.
Pull the bell up and guide it into the rack position at your shoulder.
Dip slightly with your knees, then explode up.
Punch the kettlebell overhead and lock out your arm.
Lower it back to the rack, then to the floor with control. Switch sides.

4606.description: A squat with a light pipe held overhead that checks your mobility and trains posture through the whole body.
instructions: Hold a PVC pipe overhead with a wide grip and arms locked out.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders.
Squat down by sitting between your hips, keeping the pipe over your mid-foot.
Go as deep as you can with your chest up and heels down.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

4734.description: A decline sit-up holding a dumbbell overhead. The long lever makes your abs work harder.
instructions: Hook your feet on a decline bench and lie back holding a dumbbell above your chest.
Extend your arms overhead behind you.
Curl your torso up, keeping the dumbbell over your head.
Reach the top with your arms above your knees.
Lower back slowly with control.

4798.description: A superman variation with the feet in suspension straps, lifting opposite arm and leg in turn. It trains the lower back and core.
instructions: Place your feet in the suspension straps and get into a plank face down.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm forward while keeping your body steady.
Return it, then lift the other arm.
Move slowly and avoid sagging your lower back.
Alternate sides for the full set.

4862.description: A shrug with a wide snatch grip. It trains the traps and grip.
instructions: Hold a barbell with a wide snatch grip at your thighs.
Stand tall with your chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

4990.description: Drive a knee toward the opposite elbow to crunch the side of your waist. It trains the obliques and lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Tuck one knee in while rotating your opposite elbow toward it.
Return and repeat to the other side.
Move with control instead of pulling on your neck.

5054.description: Seated backbend with hips lifted, like an upside down table. It opens the chest, shoulders and front of the hips.
instructions: Sit with knees bent and hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press into your hands and feet.
Lift your hips until your torso is flat.
Let your head relax back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

5118.description: Rotate your torso against a cable. It strengthens the obliques and builds control of your trunk rotation.
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso away from the cable, arms extended.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

5310.description: A side lunge performed with the lunging foot on a raised platform for extra range. Works glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand tall next to a low step or platform.
Step one foot sideways onto the platform.
Push your hips back and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and the planted foot flat.
Push back to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

5374.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the biceps. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie face down with the roller under one upper arm.
Place the roller under the biceps and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly from the elbow toward the shoulder.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5630.description: Squat with feet close together to emphasise the quads.
instructions: Stand with feet close together.
Extend your arms forward for balance.
Sit down and back, keeping your heels down.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
Press up to stand.

5822.description: Lie face down and lift your arms overhead in a Y. It builds the lower traps and the muscles that support the shoulder blades.
instructions: Lie face down with arms stretched overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs up.
Lift your arms, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control.

5886.description: A hip hinge with a rotation toward the floor, training the glutes and hamstrings while the trunk learns to twist under load.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a kettlebell in both hands.
Push your hips back and lower the bell toward the outside of one foot.
Rotate your torso slightly as you reach, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand and unwind.
Repeat to the same side, then switch.

6014.description: Stepping in place while raising your arms, a gentle cardio drill.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step in place, lifting your knees.
Raise your arms overhead as you step.
Lower them as you continue.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

6142.description: The Arnold press performed in reverse, rotating the palms inward on the way down. It works all three heads of the shoulder.
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells overhead with your palms forward.
Lower the weights while rotating your palms toward you.
Stop with the dumbbells in front of your chest.
Rotate your palms back outward as you press up.
Lock out the arms overhead.
Keep your back against the pad.

6270.description: A bench press with your feet raised off the floor. It trains the chest with less leg drive.
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the bar.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Unrack the bar.
Lower it to your chest.
Press back up.
Keep your back flat.

6910.description: A push-up between parallel bars that lets you sink deeper than the floor allows. It gives the chest a greater stretch.
instructions: Grip two parallel bars and hold a straight plank position.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Lower your chest below the level of your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in one line throughout.

7230.description: A wide-stance row between two kettlebells, alternating arms. It trains the lats and the core.
instructions: Place two kettlebells on the floor between your wide stance.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grab both handles.
Row one kettlebell to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it and row the other side.
Keep your hips and shoulders square.

7294.description: A small floor movement that teaches you to control the tilt of your pelvis and relax the lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Take a breath in with a neutral spine.
Exhale, tilting your pelvis so your lower back presses into the floor.
Hold for a moment.
Release back to neutral.
Repeat slowly.

7550.description: Rear-foot elevated split squat with the front foot raised for greater depth.
instructions: Stand with your front foot on a low platform and your rear foot on a bench.
Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lower until your back knee is near the floor.
Keep your front knee steady.
Drive up and switch legs.

8702.description: A hard push of a torque tank sled across the floor that fires up the legs and the heart.
instructions: Grip the handles of the tank and lean forward.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Drive with short, powerful steps.
Keep your hips low and push over the distance.
Rest and repeat.

8894.description: A push-up with a knee tuck toward the chest at the top. It combines upper body pressing with an ab crunch.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Return the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level.

10046.description: Lying face up, you sweep arms and legs out like a snow angel. It trains the abs and keeps your shoulders mobile.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs together.
Press your lower back toward the floor.
Sweep your arms overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back together in the same arc.
Repeat at a steady pace.
Keep your abs braced and lower back flat.

10110.description: A reverse curl with a thick bar, which challenges your grip and the forearm muscles even more.
instructions: Hold a fat barbell with an overhand grip.
Stand with elbows by your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your wrists straight.

10366.description: A seated move that pulls the toes toward the shins against a band to strengthen the front of the lower leg.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out and loop a band around your foot, anchored in front.
Keep your leg straight and your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin against the band.
Hold briefly, then slowly release.
Do all reps on one foot, then switch.

10558.description: Sit up while raising a medicine ball overhead and slam it down. It combines a crunch with power.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Sit up in one motion, bringing the ball forward.
Slam the ball down in front of your feet.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up.
Lie back with control and repeat.

10750.description: A smooth transition from kneeling to standing. It builds leg strength and control.
instructions: Kneel with your torso upright.
Place one foot forward into a lunge.
Push through that foot to stand.
Bring your back foot to meet it.
Reverse the motion to return to kneeling.
Alternate the lead leg.

11006.description: A seated stretch that crosses the arms and then opens the chest. It loosens the upper body.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair.
Cross your arms in front of your chest and hug yourself.
Open your arms wide and push your chest out.
Hold the open position for 5-10 seconds.
Repeat.

11262.description: A lying leg-raise style core move against cable resistance, alternating legs. It hits the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet attached to a low cable and hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Bring one bent knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.
Keep a controlled alternating rhythm.

11646.description: Squeezing the glutes and holding without moving, a simple way to activate the hips.
instructions: Lie on your back or stand with your body relaxed.
Squeeze both glute muscles together.
Keep your legs and back still.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Release fully.
Repeat for several reps.

0062.description: A bent-over row with a close grip that puts extra work on the lats and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Hold a barbell with a narrow, underhand or neutral grip, hinge at the hips and keep your back flat.
Let the bar hang at arm's length below your chest.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the bar under control until your arms are straight.
Keep your neck neutral and avoid jerking with your lower back.

0126.description: A seated wrist curl with palms up. Builds the forearm flexors.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your forearms resting on your thighs, holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Allow the barbell to roll down to your fingertips, keeping your wrists straight.
Slowly curl the barbell up towards your forearms by flexing your wrists.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，前臂放在大腿上，反握杠铃。
让杠铃向下滚动到指尖，保持手腕伸直。
弯曲手腕，慢慢地将杠铃向上卷向前臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0190.description: A one-arm standing cable curl. The cable keeps the biceps under tension from bottom to top.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable handle with an underhand grip, palm facing up.
Keep your elbow close to your side and slowly curl your forearm up towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
反手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝上。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，慢慢地将前臂向上卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0318.description: The incline dumbbell curl. You sit back on an inclined bench and curl up, stretching the biceps at the start.
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Rest your upper arms on the incline bench and let your elbows hang down, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将上斜凳摆成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向前。
将上臂放在上斜凳上，让肘部下垂，充分伸展手臂。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0382.description: You curl dumbbells with an overhand grip. It trains the biceps, the muscle under them and the forearms.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝下，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0446.description: You curl an EZ bar with a narrow grip. It emphasises the outer part of the biceps.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Curl the barbell up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，双手分开与肩同宽。
在整个运动过程中，保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
将杠铃向上弯向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0510.description: A jumping lunge that finishes with a jumping jack. It is a high-intensity move for legs and conditioning.
instructions: Start standing tall with feet together.
Step into a lunge and drop your back knee toward the floor.
Jump and switch legs in the air, landing in a lunge on the other side.
Jump up and land with feet wide as you swing your arms overhead, like a jumping jack.
Jump the feet back together and return to the start.
Land softly and keep your chest up.

0574.description: A lever machine version of the bent over row. You pull the handles toward your torso to train the back and lats.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Pull the barbell towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将杠铃拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0638.description: An advanced pull-up using only one arm. Builds big lat and biceps strength and takes lots of practice.
instructions: Stand facing a pull-up bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach up and grab the bar with an underhand grip, with one hand gripping the bar and the other hand holding your wrist for support.
Hang from the bar with your arm fully extended, keeping your body straight and your core engaged.
Pull yourself up towards the bar by bending your elbow and squeezing your back muscles.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms and repeat.
instructionsZh: 面向引体向上杆站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
抬起手，用反握方式抓住杠铃，一只手握住杠铃，另一只手握住手腕以提供支撑。
悬挂在杠上，手臂完全伸展，保持身体伸直，核心肌群参与。
弯曲肘部并挤压背部肌肉，将自己拉向杠铃。
继续拉，直到下巴高于杠铃，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂重复。

0702.description: A side plank with a knee tuck for extra core work. It trains the obliques and hip flexors.
instructions: Start in a side plank on your forearm.
Raise your top leg slightly.
Pull your top knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg back.
Keep your hips lifted.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

0766.description: An overhead press using the smith bar, pressed from shoulder height to full extension. It builds strong shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and position it at shoulder level, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the bar upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在史密斯机上，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其置于与肩同高的位置，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
向上推杠铃，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

0830.description: A bench dip with added weight on the lap or hips. It builds the triceps and chest.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0894.description: A calf raise with band resistance. It builds the calves and ankle strength.
instructions: Sit or stand with the band looped under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly.
Press up onto your toes against the band.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

0958.description: Sit with legs wide and fold forward over them. It stretches the inner thighs and hamstrings.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs spread as wide as is comfortable.
Flex your feet and keep your knees pointing up.
Walk your hands forward and fold from the hips.
Keep your spine long instead of rounding.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
